summary: Comprehensive testing of Turkish coupon platform completed. Backend APIs 100% functional, but critical frontend coupon modal issue identified. Most features working correctly including admin panel, search, navigation, and mobile responsiveness.

ui_bugs.issue: Coupon buttons not opening modal - redirecting directly instead of showing coupon code first
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot see coupon codes before being redirected

integration_issues.issue: Expected modal behavior not working - buttons redirect immediately

design_issues.issue: Test data-testid attributes missing for some components
design_issues.note: Components work but use different selectors than expected

passed_tests: All 12 backend API endpoints (100% success rate)
Brand pages with 5 tabs (Tümü, Kuponlar, İndirimler, Uygulama)
Discount cards display (11 found on Nike page)
Demo data: Nike, Adidas, Puma brands with proper content
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix coupon modal functionality - coupon buttons should open modal with coupon code first, then allow user to proceed to store. Currently buttons redirect immediately without showing modal.
